why: The relation probes showed that a relation word can be present while the sentence is wrong. Relation presence is therefore demoted to a clue, and three checks are judged separately.

factRelation.question: is the arrangement in the fact still there
factRelation.note: kept requires the declared relation token; this is a clue and does not by itself pass the unit

entityAttribution.question: does the name keep the role the fact gives it (possessor / location reference / agent)
entityAttribution.roleFlipRule: the text contains <name>的 followed immediately by the other entity or by the relation phrase; that turns a location reference into a possessor
entityAttribution.duplicatedRule: the name string occurs two or more times

syntax.question: is the sentence well formed
brokenWhen: a clause has no predicate after 的

pass: a unit passes only when factRelation=kept and entityAttribution=ok and syntax=ok

roleInventory.possessor: the name owns the following noun (潮汐簿的缺页, 鱼筐的边沿)
roleInventory.locationReference: the name is where the value's own subject is attached or placed (木桩 in 缠着的旧缆绳断了, 长桌 in 盖在上面的干纸滑开了)
roleInventory.agent: the name performs the action (沈砚把灯罩擦得透亮)

declared: written before re-judging the archived relation outputs; the old retention-only judgement stays as is
